View your current speed with a scalable speedometer.

* ODOMETER *
Display your total distance.

* TRIP TRACKING *
Calculate your max, and average speed, and a lot of data on your trip.

* TRIP EXPORTING *
Export your trip data to files (GPX, CSV, KML)

* SPEED LIMIT REMINDER *
Remind you when you've exceeded the limit speed or gone under the minimum speed limit.

* SPEED GRAPH *
View your trip with maps and a speed graph.

* HUD *
The head-up display interface will display your dashboard right on the windshield.

* STYLES *
View your speedometer in light and dark mode.

NOTE
* Continued GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
* GPS is not always accurate due to device hardware sensor limitations.
